gloss: to begin; to set about; to start working on

definitions.gloss: to begin; to set about; to start working on
definitions.explanation: To begin working on a task or project. Implies actively getting started rather than just deciding to do something.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}に{取|と}り{掛|か}かる。
すぐに{準備|じゅんび}に{取|と}り{掛|か}かった。
{朝|あさ}ごはんを{食|た}べたら、{宿題|しゅくだい}に{取|と}り{掛|か}かりなさい。
examples.english: After you eat breakfast, get started on your homework.

notes:
A godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし}) meaning to begin or set about doing something. Takes the particle に to mark the task being started.

CONJUGATION:
Godan verb with る ending. Dictionary form: {取|と}り{掛|か}かる. Te-form: {取|と}り{掛|か}かって. Past: {取|と}り{掛|か}かった.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～に{取|と}り{掛|か}かる: to start working on ~
- すぐに{取|と}り{掛|か}かる: to get right on it
- {早速|さっそく}{取|と}り{掛|か}かる: to set about it at once

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {始|はじ}める: to begin — general purpose, more neutral
- {着手|ちゃくしゅ}する: to commence, to embark on — more formal, used for projects or official tasks

{取|と}り{掛|か}かる emphasizes the act of physically getting started on a task, implying rolling up one's sleeves and diving in.
